descriptions.w3d_cc17d_endpoint_has_queued_802cba50: For endpoint slot index 0..15: calls 0x802cb314 with the index and, when the word at 0x804abce4 is nonzero, returns 1 if the slot's 16-byte vector record at 0x804737a4 holds at least one 4-byte element, else 0.
descriptions.w3d_cc17d_endpoint_query_802cbacc: When the word at 0x804abce4 is nonzero and the index is 0..15: calls 0x802cb314 with the index and, if the slot's active word at 0x80473724 is set, returns whether the slot's endpoint interface (0x804738a4) answers nonzero from vtable slot +48; otherwise 0.
